
### C and cache misses (struct)  {.smaller}


```c
typedef struct {
    int a_value, b_value;
    int other_values[10];
} item;
item items[5];
int a_sum = 0, b_sum = 0;
for (int i = 0; i < 5; ++i)
    a_sum += items[i].a_value;
for (int i = 0; i < 5; ++i)
    b_sum += items[i].b_value;
```
 

* observation: 12 ints in struct: only first two used
* equivalent to accessing array[0], array[12], array[24], etc.
* … then accessing array[1], array[13], array[25], etc.


### C and cache misses (struct, rewritten?)  {.smaller}


```c
typedef struct {
    int a_value, b_value;
    int other_values[10];
} item;
item items[5];
int a_sum = 0, b_sum = 0;
for (int i = 0; i < 5; ++i)
    a_sum += items[i].a_value;
for (int i = 0; i < 5; ++i)
    b_sum += items[i].b_value;
```

<hr/>

```c
int array[60];
int a_sum = 0, b_sum = 0;
for (int i = 0; i < 60; i += 12)
    a_sum += array[i];
for (int i = 1; i < 60; i += 12)
    b_sum += array[i];
```
